description: 2RN Shopping helps users discover and compare physical products from connected retailers directly in a conversation. It can apply a search query, price limit, delivery country, availability, and product attributes; show when a price was observed; compare offers; and find less expensive alternatives. AliExpress requests are routed to an eligible regional catalog from the explicit delivery country, never from an IP address, VPN location, or interface language. The plugin never places or pays for an order. The user reviews the final terms and completes any purchase on the retailer's website. Some outbound links may include affiliate attribution at no additional cost to the user; commission never affects ranking. Supported retailers and regions are shown dynamically and may expand as new integrations are verified.

defaultPrompt: Find contact lens solutions at Ochkarik under RUB 500 and sort them by price.
Find wireless earbuds on AliExpress under RUB 3,000 with delivery to Russia.
Compare two product offers by price, rating, availability, and specifications.
